verdict.rationale: Starting an online filing without an account is a fair question for a national company registry, so the axis applies. The pack holds only two probes showing HTTP 403 at robots.txt on mca.gov.in and nsws.gov.in, and no published page content was fetched. That says nothing about whether a keyless or file-number entry path exists, so there is no evidence the product delivers the story.

support.subject: As a founder, I can start the core online flow without creating an account first — the service's published pages document a keyless or file-number entry path
